name: Claude Code Tutorial
headline: claude code cli中文教程
short_description: Claude Code CLI 中文教程 helps developers master AI-assisted coding. It covers setup, hooks, skills, MCP integration, and enterprise best practices. Ideal for operations teams automating workflows with Claude.
author: hiliyongke

sections.overview:
Claude Code 完全指南 is a structured technical tutorial for Anthropic's Claude Code intelligent programming tool, covering setup through advanced capabilities. The guide spans seven progressive sections—from introductory concepts and installation to enterprise-grade deployment, cost optimization, and security best practices. It provides developers with systematic knowledge on headless mode, prompt engineering, MCP protocol integration, and GitHub Actions workflows. Readers learn to extend Claude Code through hooks, skills, and specs, and discover patterns for team training, compliance auditing, and multi-language development. The tutorial is grounded in Claude 3.5/4.5 model capabilities and includes practical examples for full-stack projects, legacy code refactoring, and CI/CD integration.
Setting up Claude Code in development environments and configuring multi-environment deployments
Integrating Claude Code with GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines
Extending Claude Code capabilities using hooks, skills, and the MCP protocol
Implementing enterprise-level security, compliance auditing, and cost control
